meta.name: voice-of-customer
meta.description: Builds the loop from what customers say to what gets changed — collecting feedback, distinguishing signal from noise, routing it to owners, and closing the loop back to the customer. Use this to set up a feedback program, design or interpret CSAT/NPS, decide what customer feedback deserves action, get product to act on recurring issues, or diagnose why feedback is collected but nothing changes.

copy.tagline: 把客户反馈转化为产品改进行动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望系统收集客户反馈并推动产品落地改进
copy.tagline_en: Turn customer feedback into product actions that matter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a systematic way to hear customers and turn their feedback into product changes

howto.what: Claude 会帮助你构建完整的客户反馈闭环：它指导你从多个渠道收集反馈，用统一分类法归类并量化，区分问题与解决方案，指定负责人推动处理，最后把改动结果反馈给客户和内部团队。同时它会提醒你避免只看满意度分数等陷阱。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建客户反馈机制、设计或解读 CSAT/NPS，或让产品团队处理反复出现的反馈问题时触发；也可用于诊断「收集了反馈却什么都没改变」的困境。

say.text: 帮我把客户支持工单里的高频问题整理成可执行的改进行动
say.note: Claude 会给出归类、量化并指派负责人的具体做法。

say.text: 我们最近 NPS 跌了很多，帮我分析可能的原因
say.note: Claude 会提示按细分维度分析，而不是只看平均分。

say.text: 客户总说要某个新功能，怎么判断该不该做？
say.note: Claude 会帮你区分客户表面提出的方案与背后的真实问题。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you in building a feedback loop: collect from multiple sources, categorize and quantify, assign owners, review, distinguish requests from real problems, and close the loop. It also warns against relying on scores alone.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up a feedback program, design or interpret CSAT/NPS, get product teams to act on recurring issues, or diagnose why collected feedback leads to no change.

say_en.text: Help me turn frequent issues in support tickets into actionable improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will show you how to categorize, quantify, and assign owners.

say_en.text: Our NPS has dropped lately. Can you help me analyze why?
say_en.note: Claude will advise segmenting the data instead of just looking at the average.

say_en.text: Customers keep requesting a new feature. How do we decide whether to build it?
say_en.note: Claude will help separate the request from the underlying problem.
